test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, who is the President of Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gotabaya Rajapaksa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lieutenant Colonel Gotabaya Rajapaksa** is a former military commander and **current President of Sri Lanka.**
 
• He has been in office since 2019. He previously served as Secretary to the Ministry of Defence and Urban Development under his elder brother, former President Mahinda Rajapaksa, from 2005 to 2015, leading the Sri Lankan Armed Forces to the military defeat of the Tamil Tigers, bringing the Sri Lankan Civil War to a conclusion.
 
• On November 18, 2019, Rajapaksa was formally inaugurated at the Ruwanwelisaya in Anuradhapura.
 
• It is Rajapaksa's first elected post, and he is the first non-career politician and former military officer to hold the position of president.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Mahinda Rajapaksa** is a Sri Lankan politician who has been the country's Prime Minister since 2019, having previously served from 2004 to 2005.
 
• **Ranil Wickremesinghe **is a Sri Lankan politician who represents the United National Party's National List in Parliament.
 
 
• Ranil Wickremesinghe is the current President of Sri Lanka (as of July 2022).
 
 
 
• **Chandrika Bandaranaike Kumaratunga** is a Sri Lankan politician who served as the country's fifth president from November 12, 1994, until November 19, 2005.
